provenance: Webshell filename IOCs are the canonical names documented publicly for the c99 / r57 / FilesMan / b374k / WSO shell families (the same list concept as phpscan's iocs.json, sourced from the public write-ups for those families and the PHP Malware Finder project, github.com/jvoisin/php-malware-finder). Scanner user-agent fingerprints are the self-identifying strings those tools send by default. The eval-stdin.php path is the UnitTest shell documented in PHPatch's October 2026 php2shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) coverage in the phpatch threat swarm. No indicator in this file is an exploit payload; every entry is a name, path or string that appears in ordinary access logs.
